title: Nobody, Nothing, No Such Thing
goal: Say that nobody or nothing fits a description, and ask whether such a person or thing exists.
grammar: Relative clauses with a negative antecedent + subjunctive

items: I can say that nobody or nothing fits a description, using nadie, nada or ningún + que + subjunctive.
I can ask whether someone or something exists, with a subjunctive after que.
I can use the new words for repairs and tools.
